message:
I agree with Iris Black (see 3rd post back) and Charlie both.  I think it would be great to organize a protest all over the country where the phones largely went silent.  Talk about hitting them where it hurts!  Whatever it would take to get that to happen would probably be worth it.

Also writing letters, as we have been doing, is much more helpful than phone calls.  For anyone new to the thread, Elvera Williams' posts throughout the thread are very useful in giving information on who to write to, or how to find out who to write to in your state.  This simply must stop.  It would be GREAT if we could get some kind of news coverage on this corruption, but I'm not sure who would champion our cause or have sympathy and be willing to take on the machine that T-Netix/Securus/Evercom and their partnership with so many state governments has become.  Sadly it's hard to get people interested in injustice to inmates families, they seem to stop caring the moment they hear the word "inmate".
